This product is supplied without battery and charger. DeWalt 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 6328D.

Gasless and brushless, lightweight nail gun designed for durability and quicker application times. Fires up to 4 nails per second, up to 63mm in softwood and 50mm in hardwood. Features sequential and bump firing modes for easier and quicker use. With stall release and LED lights with error notification. Protective pads when tool is placed on the floor either sideways or on the head. Suitable for skirting, architrave, beading, cladding, cabinet trim, staircases, soffit and coving. For second fix applications. Compatible with DEWALT XR Li-ion slide pack batteries.
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
